channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz que Lava Jato foi a ‘grande mentira do século’ no Brasil
item.description: President Lula labeled Operation Lava Jato the 'great lie of the 21st century' in Brazil, criticizing its economic impact, which led to the loss of 4.44 million jobs between 2014 and 2017, according to a Dieese study. He argued the operation aimed to destroy companies rather than punish only corrupt individuals, and highlighted collateral damage to consumption and income, affecting sectors like commerce and transport. Lula urged youth to engage in politics to foster honesty and expressed concern over declining public trust in political leaders.

item.title: Em 2º turno, Lula amplia vantagem sobre Caiado e vai a 48% das intenções, segundo Datafolha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) slightly widened his lead over former governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) in a potential presidential runoff for 2026, reaching 48% of voting intentions according to a Datafolha poll released Friday, the 22nd. The result signals a favorable scenario for Lula in a hypothetical direct contest against Caiado.

item.title: Lula diz que vetará possibilidade de robôs em eleições em projeto que blinda partidos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he will veto provisions of a bill approved by the Chamber of Deputies that allows candidates to send mass messages during elections, arguing it could enable the use of bots and disinformation. He said the measure aims to protect political parties from practices that undermine electoral integrity.

item.title: Ministros dizem que lei eleitoral prevalece sobre manobra do Congresso para liberar doações
item.description: The ministers of Planning and Budget and of Finance stated that electoral law prevails over the congressional maneuver to allow donations of goods and money during the campaign, even after the presidential veto was overturned. They emphasized that electoral norms hold superior hierarchy and must be respected, regardless of subsequent legislative changes. The statement reinforces the government’s position that any changes to campaign financing must comply with rules set by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Datafolha: Sem Flávio em 1º turno, Lula tem 41%, Michelle 22%, Zema 6%, Caiado 5%, e Renan 3%
item.description: In a first-round scenario without Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula leads with 41% voting intentions, followed by Michelle Bolsonaro at 22%, Zema at 6%, Caiado at 5%, and Renan at 3%, according to Datafolha. The absence of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro shifts the race dynamics, directly benefiting Michelle Bolsonaro’s candidacy, which inherits part of the Bolsonarist electorate.

item.title: Brigo todo santo dia para gasolina abaixar, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula said he works every day to lower gasoline prices, citing measures such as cutting PIS/Cofins on diesel, temporary subsidies, taxing petroleum exports, and negotiating with governors to reduce fuel ICMS. He also mentioned meetings with Petrobras and plans to strengthen oversight by the Federal Police and ANP against abusive price hikes.

item.title: Justiça da Itália anula decisão sobre extradição de Zambelli
item.description: Italy's Court of Cassation overturned the decision authorizing the extradition of former deputy Carla Zambelli to Brazil, keeping her detained in Rome since July 2025. Zambelli was convicted by Brazil's Supreme Court for involvement in hacking the CNJ system and for illegally brandishing a firearm while pursuing a man in São Paulo on the eve of the 2022 election runoff. The final decision on extradition now rests with Italian Justice Minister Carlo Nordio.

item.title: A insólita frase que Lula diz ter proferido a Trump em recente encontro
item.description: Lula stated that he told Donald Trump in a recent meeting that the U.S. president was not elected to be 'emperor of the world', but to govern the United States. The comment was made during an interview on the program Sem Censura on Friday, the 22nd, in response to a moment of disagreement between the two leaders. The remark reflects a critique of Trump’s international posture and a defense of multilateralism.

item.title: “Tenho mais experiência que ele”, diz Lula sobre Trump
item.description: President Lula claimed he has more political experience than Donald Trump, explaining that he requested a private meeting to avoid diplomatic embarrassment and ensured the setting allowed for an 'equal footing' conversation during their May 7 bilateral talk. He said he provided Trump with documents on public security, international arms trafficking, and money laundering, warning against aides removing the documents without reading them, and noted that many seized weapons in Brazil originate from the U.S. While criticizing the American tendency to equate Latin America solely with crime and drugs, Lula said he was treated with great respect by Trump during the meeting.

item.title: Governo fixa a subvenção da gasolina em R$ 0,44 por litro
item.description: The federal government has set a gasoline subsidy of R$0.44 per liter, equivalent to about half of the federal taxes on the fuel, to mitigate the impact of international oil price increases caused by the war in Iran. The measure is estimated to cost R$2.4 billion over an initial two-month period and awaits presidential approval before implementation via an act by the Ministry of Finance.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro comemora decisão da Justiça italiana sobre Zambelli: "Carla livre!"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated on social media the annulment of the extradition process of former deputy Carla Zambelli by the Italian Justice, writing 'Carla FREE!!!' and reposting a video of the parliamentarian's mother with the phrase 'God in command!'. The decision by Rome's Court of Cassation annulled the prior authorization for extradition, identifying flaws in the process related to Zambelli's convictions for hacking the CNJ's system and illegal firearm possession.

item.title: Dino não vai receber Mario Frias após deputado se colocar à disposição
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino has declined to meet with federal deputy Mario Frias (PL-SP) in his office, citing concerns about breaking equality with other parliamentarians under investigation for amendments. Frias, who was abroad, stated he is available to provide clarifications upon his return on May 25, but Dino maintained his decision not to schedule a personal meeting.

item.title: PL e Centrão minimizam recuo de Flávio no Datafolha, mas temem queda maior caso surjam novos fatos
item.description: The PL and Centrão downplayed Flávio Bolsonaro's four-point drop in the Datafolha poll, attributing it to the temporary impact of the 'Dark Horse' case. While they consider the decline recoverable, there is internal concern that new revelations—such as evidence of wrongdoing—could jeopardize his candidacy. Michelle Bolsonaro is seen as having strong electoral potential, but the party avoids elevating her nationally to prevent overshadowing Flávio within the Bolsonarist base.

item.title: Deputado pede que TCE-MG apure se empresas de Vorcaro tiveram isenção
item.description: State deputy Professor Cleiton (PV) filed a request with the TCE-MG to investigate whether companies linked to the Vorcaro family — such as Asset Energy Holding LTDA, Infrasolar Holding LTDA and Green Investimentos SA — received improper tax benefits during Governor Romeu Zema’s administration. The request includes examining possible ties to donations made by Henrique Vorcaro to the Novo party and cross-referencing company shareholders with campaign donors. Fiscal renunciation under Zema rose from R$ 4.8 million to R$ 22.4 million, nearly quintupling, raising concerns of favoritism.

item.title: Em semana de juros globais pressionados, dólar e Bolsa tem leve queda
item.description: The escalating conflict between the United States and Iran pressured global markets this week, with the Ibovespa falling 1.2% and the dollar rising 0.55% on Friday, driven by oil prices above $100 and fears of prolonged inflation. The release of audio linking Daniel Vorcarol to presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro also negatively impacted assets, according to analysts. Global long-term bond yields rose, with U.S. 30-year Treasuries reaching 5.2%, reflecting expectations of higher interest rates for an extended period.

item.title: Aliado de Flávio diz que Datafolha surpreendeu "quem esperava tragédia"
item.description: Senator Marcos Rogério (PL-RO), an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, said the latest Datafolha poll did not produce the negative impact some had expected on Bolsonaro’s campaign, stating that 'for those who expected a tragedy, it seems it did not come.' He also ruled out replacing Flávio Bolsonaro with Michelle Bolsonaro as the PL’s 2026 candidate. According to Datafolha, Lula leads with 47% against Flávio Bolsonaro’s 43% in a potential runoff, expanding his lead from 1 to 4 points since the previous survey.

item.title: Eleições: Lula promete vetar PL sobre envio em massa de mensagens
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced he will veto the electoral mini-reform bill approved by the Chamber of Deputies, which allows mass automated messaging to pre-registered voters. Lula called the measure a threat to democracy, saying it encourages the use of bots and artificial intelligence in elections, and stated he will work to block its approval in the Senate before issuing a veto. He also criticized the growing public funds allocated to lawmakers and parties, linking them to political promiscuity.

item.title: Flavio quer mostrar proximidade com Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro plans to meet with Donald Trump in the U.S. to demonstrate that Bolsonarism maintains channels of dialogue with the former American president, countering perceptions of isolation following Lula’s meeting with Trump. The initiative aims to reinforce the image that the Bolsonarist movement still holds international relevance, especially amid criticisms of the Lula government’s alleged alignment with left-wing regimes. Foreign policy, traditionally absent from Brazilian electoral campaigns, becomes a central theme in this narrative strategy.

item.title: MP investiga campanha ilegal para Lula e governador em show do Raça Negra no Piauí
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry of Piaui is investigating alleged illegal campaigning in favor of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Governor Rafael Fonteles during a February concert by the band Raça Negra, which used public funds and featured political praise from Senator Jussara Lima and Federal Deputy Julio Cesar. Matters concerning Lula will be referred to the PGR, while the Regional Electoral Prosecution will handle the case against the governor. Initial steps include requesting contracting documents from the city of Barras, reviewing social media records, and notifying the individuals involved to provide statements.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula inventa uma nova categoria de vítima
item.description: The O Antagonista article claims President Lula has a distorted view of criminals, seeing them always as victims of society rather than as responsible for their illegal choices. Lula, who was previously convicted of passive corruption and money laundering, is accused of prioritizing leniency over punishment, framing crime as a product of social injustice rather than individual decisions.

item.title: Ministro de Lula aponta ajustes e problemas com free flow de Tarcísio. Veja vídeo
item.description: Transport Minister George Santoro criticized the implementation of the free-flow toll system in São Paulo, stating it was poorly executed due to lack of signage and user information. He confirmed the federal government suspended all fines and reopened payment deadlines after identifying improper charges, especially affecting drivers without electronic tags. Santoro added that the São Paulo state government has acknowledged the issue and is adjusting the contract, expecting the system to become a solution in the future.

item.title: Brechós retornam ao Metrópoles Fashion & Design em 2026; veja lista
item.description: The Metrópoles Fashion & Design 2026 returns from June 10 to 12 at the National Museum of the Republic, featuring luxury, streetwear, and curated thrift shops, including returning participants such as Lixo Mania, Choose Brasília, By Bela Shop, To Face Brechó, Rua de Baixo Brechó, Nasty Brechó, Só Usei Uma Vez, Desapeguei Bonito, and GGarimpei. The event includes the MFD Challenge 2026, inviting Brasília talents to transform Brazilian folklore into original creations using fabric scraps and handmade patchwork techniques.

item.title: Lula diz que Lava Jato foi “maior mentira do século” no Brasil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva denounced Operation Car Wash (Lava Jato) as 'the biggest lie of the 21st century' in Brazil, claiming it was fueled by media outlets and failed to prove the accusations made against him and others. He emphasized the operation's economic damage, stating it destroyed national companies and approximately 4 million jobs, and questioned whom it truly served. Lula also criticized the press for not apologizing for its errors and warned that constant corruption scandals erode public trust in politics and institutions.

item.title: Justiça da Itália nega extradição de Carla Zambelli
item.description: Italy’s Court of Cassation annulled the extradition of former deputy Carla Zambelli, recognizing her as a politically persecuted individual and deeming the evidence against her insufficient. She is expected to be released between March 23 and 26, pending the Italian Justice Minister’s opinion within 45 days. The ruling nullifies both extradition requests tied to her STF convictions for CNJ system invasion and illegal firearm possession during the 2022 elections.

item.title: A derrubada dos vetos na LDO e o peso sobre as contas públicas, inflação e juros
item.description: The congressional override of four presidential vetoes to the Budget Guidelines Law (LDO) has reignited concerns about Brazil’s fiscal fragility, particularly in an election year. Economists warn the move increases public spending, pressures public debt, reduces space for investment, and may lead the central bank to keep interest rates higher for longer due to inflation risks.

item.title: Lula ignora Neymar e faz elogio rasgado a Romário: ‘é um gênio’
item.description: President Lula praised Romário as a 'genius' of Brazilian football, highlighting his irreverence and performance as a center forward in the 1994 World Cup, without mentioning Neymar despite his recent call-up. Lula said he does not care about Romário’s party (PL) and admires the player for his personality and legacy in the sport.

item.title: Lula abre vantagem após notícias ligando Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released Friday morning shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva gaining a numerical lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a potential runoff, following news linking Bolsonaro’s son to Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master. The survey was conducted after the revelation of the alleged relationship between Flávio Bolsonaro and Vorcaro, which negatively affected Bolsonaro’s electoral standing.

item.title: Queda de marqueteiro de Flávio expőe racha entre moderados e ideológicos
item.description: The departure of marketer Marcello Lopes from Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign exposes an internal split between moderate and ideological factions, mirroring divisions seen during Jair Bolsonaro’s government. This rupture highlights disagreements over campaign direction, strategy, and messaging. The episode underscores the fragility of cohesion within the Bolsonarist orbit ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Zema eleva críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Quem estiver do lado de corrupto năo conte comigo'
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for President from the Novo party, sharply criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he would not support anyone aligned with corrupt figures. The remarks suggest a potential break with Bolsonarism, intensifying tensions within Brazil’s right-wing political spectrum.

item.title: Lula e Janja reúnem ministros para discutir combate à fome
item.description: Lula and Janja met with ministers to discuss the FAO's Global Alliance Against Hunger and Poverty, launched in November 2024 with 13 countries and 17 ongoing projects, and offices in Rome, Brasília, Ethiopia, Thailand, and Washington D.C. Brazil exited the Hunger Map in 2025 after re-entering it between 2018 and 2020 due to cuts in social programs, with 24 million people leaving severe food insecurity by the end of 2023. Lula emphasized that hunger is a political choice, resulting from government and economic decisions that ignore or promote inequality.

item.title: Lula discutirá obras e combate ao crime com presidente do Suriname
item.description: President Lula will meet with Suriname's President Jennifer Geerlings-Simons in Brasília to discuss infrastructure projects, a northern Brazil maritime route, food security, and strengthened cooperation against transnational organized crime, aiming for concrete solutions to boost bilateral trade and Amazon stability.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula absolve compradores de celulares roubados
item.description: President Lula was criticized for suggesting that buyers of stolen smartphones should not be punished, contradicting Article 180 of the Brazilian Penal Code, which penalizes receptivity even when there are signs of illicit origin, such as suspiciously low prices. The statement drew backlash for ignoring consumer responsibility in curbing the market for stolen goods. The O Antagonista post frames the remark as an improperly attributed absolution by the president.

item.title: Datafolha: Rejeição a Flávio Bolsonaro sobe após revelação de conversas com Vorcaro e supera numericamente a de Lula
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) rejection rose from 43% to 46% after revelations of conversations with Vorcaro in the 'Dark Horse' case, surpassing Lula’s (PT) rejection, which dropped from 47% to 45%. Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) has 31% rejection, not previously tested. Other pre-candidates remain under 20%.

item.title: Lula tem 47% e Flávio 43% no segundo turno, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads with 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 43% in a technical tie within the margin of error for the second round. In the first round, Lula expands his lead to 40% versus 31% for Flávio, based on a Datafolha survey conducted May 20–21 with 2,004 in-person interviews.

item.title: Datafolha: Michelle Bolsonaro tem 43% contra 48% de Lula em simulação de segundo turno
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Michelle Bolsonaro at 43% versus Lula's 48% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, with 8% blank/null votes and 1% undecided. The former first lady replaced Flavio Bolsonaro in the simulation after the 'Dark Horse' scandal involving his alleged undisclosed talks with Banco Master's Daniel Vorcaro. The PL party will decide by early June whether to keep Flavio in the race, amid Jair Bolsonaro's insistence and allied discomfort over the revelations.

item.title: As intenções de voto de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno em novo Datafolha
item.description: Lula regained the lead in a hypothetical second-round runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, with 47% voting intentions compared to 43%, according to a new Datafolha poll released after the disclosure of conversations between the senator and banker Daniel Vorcaro regarding multimillion-dollar transfers for a Jair Bolsonaro propaganda film. The survey, conducted with a margin of error of two percentage points at 95% confidence, shows 9% would vote blank or null and 2% are undecided. The result confirms a trend previously indicated by AtlasIntel and contrasts with the technical tie recorded before the audio leak.

item.title: Governo vai estabelecer subsídio de R$ 0,44 por litro de gasolina, diz ministro do Planejamento
item.description: Planning Minister Bruno Moretti announced the government will establish a subsidy of R$ 0,44 per liter of gasoline, with a monthly cost of R$ 1,2 billion, to be offset by increased oil revenue from international markets. The decree will be presented to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva next Monday and will be paid directly to producers and importers via the ANP, aiming to cushion the price shock from the Middle East conflict-driven oil surge. The subsidy will initially apply to gasoline and may be extended to diesel after a current provisional measure expires.

item.title: Zema eleva críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Quem estiver do lado de corrupto não conte comigo’
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential pre-candidate, intensified his criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro, stating he is 'breaking with what I have always condemned' following the revelations of Flávio's conversations with banker Daniel Vorcaro, whom Zema labeled a 'crook'. Zema emphasized he never used his family name for political gain and declared he would not support anyone aligned with corruption, questioning the credibility of such alliances.

item.title: Após subir impostos nos últimos anos, governo estima nível recorde para a arrecadação em 2026
item.description: The government estimates that tax and federal revenue collection will reach 23.6% of GDP in 2026, a record level matching 2010, following years of tax increases. The fiscal 'recomposition' policy led by Finance Minister Dario Durigan emphasizes tax justice, with relief for workers and income tax exemptions for 10 million people, while reversing benefits and taxing high incomes, offshore entities, betting, and interest on equity.

item.title: Fachin propõe padronizar penduricalhos em contracheque único
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Edson Fachin, president of the STF and CNJ, proposed a resolution to establish a single paycheck for all judiciary magistrates, featuring a Unified Remuneration Table that standardizes the nomenclature of all payroll items, including additional payments. The measure aims to eliminate parallel payment slips and increase transparency by requiring courts to publish detailed breakdowns of earnings. The CNJ plenary will review the proposal on May 26, with a 60-day adaptation period if approved.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula abre vantagem sobre Flávio após 'Dark Horse'
item.description: In the first Datafolha poll following the 'Dark Horse' scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, President Lula (PT) expanded his lead in the first-round simulation from 3 to 9 points, reaching 40% voting intention against 31% for the Bolsonarist senator.

item.title: Kassio indica Mendonça para atuar em ações sobre propaganda eleitoral no TSE e fecha lista de relatores do pleito deste ano
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques appointed André Mendonça as auxiliary judge for electoral propaganda matters, alongside Minister Estela Aranha. The official gazette published a directive stating that preliminary decisions on electoral propaganda will be immediately submitted to the TSE Plenary, possibly for virtual judgment. Mendonça's inclusion reflects Kassio's aim to foster a more collaborative leadership.

item.title: O encontro entre Lula e Motta para amarrar texto final da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta is set to meet with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by next Monday to finalize the text of the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule. The goal is to vote on the proposal in the special committee and plenary by the end of next week, with the transition period being the central topic of discussion. Motta also plans to meet with rapporteur Leo Prates and party leaders to secure a strong vote, as even the opposition acknowledges the proposal’s popular and electoral appeal.

item.title: A expectativa da campanha de Lula sobre a candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign coordinator, Senator Camilo Santana, assessed that the case involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro could influence voter perception in the 2026 presidential election, raising questions about the candidate's discourse consistency and political ties. He noted such episodes affect public perception and that the Lula campaign is monitoring developments closely, while refraining from definitively judging Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy viability, stating that voters will ultimately decide.

item.title: O preço do futuro (parte 2)
item.description: The text examines the evolution of political event prediction markets, particularly for elections, contrasting regulated platforms like Kalshi (overseen by the CFTC in the U.S.) with decentralized ones like Polymarket. The core debate is whether these contracts should be classified as financial instruments or as forms of betting, with significant implications for regulation, market integrity, and participant protection. In Brazil, it remains unclear which authority — CVM, Central Bank, or another — should oversee such markets.

item.title: Os próximos capítulos da investigação contra Lulinha no STF
item.description: The Federal Police found compromising messages from Lulinha, son of President Lula, with individuals investigated in the billion-dollar INSS fraud scheme, raising suspicions of undue interference in the investigation. Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça may act to investigate possible obstruction of justice. Lulinha’s defense, led by lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, denies knowledge of the messages, asserts his innocence, and states he wishes to cooperate with the investigations.

item.title: Kassio e Mendonça cuidarão de processos no TSE sobre propaganda eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques appointed Minister André Mendonça as an auxiliary judge for electoral propaganda, alongside Minister Estela Aranha. The three will oversee the distribution and adjudication of electoral propaganda-related cases, including injunctions and right-of-reply requests, with decisions submitted to the TSE plenary, including virtually. The cases will cover fake news, electronic voting machine attacks, AI, and social media.

item.title: Ficha Limpa: Cármen Lúcia vota contra reduzir prazo de inelegibilidade
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia voted to overturn changes to the Clean Record Law made by Complementary Law 219/2025, advocating for a return to stricter timelines for ineligibility. Her vote could reinstate the ineligibility of politicians such as Eduardo Cunha, Anthony Garotinho, and José Roberto Arruda, impacting their 2026 candidacies. The STF ruling, ongoing until May 29, may restore the original rigor of the law regarding mandate loss, resignation, and convictions for corruption and improbity.

item.title: Clica e Confirma: presidente do TSE afirma que tecnologia fortalece a democracia
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Nunes Marques, stated that technology, including Artificial Intelligence, strengthens democracy when combined with transparency and public oversight. The Clica e Confirma program also explained how the 'virtual piggyback' works for campaign fundraising, allowed from May 15, and detailed the services available to voters after the electoral roll closed on May 6, with reopening scheduled for November 3.

item.title: "Bloco da ilegalidade nunca foi tão forte e unido no Brasil", diz Dino
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino stated that the 'bloc of illegality' has never been as strong and united in Brazil, citing armed groups, money laundering, distorted parliamentary amendments, and the trading of judicial decisions. He emphasized that the STF is not the nation's enemy but a permanent guardian of the Constitution, during an event where he received an honorary doctorate from PUC-SP.
